name: my-job-agent
description: Distributed job agent system with backend workers and dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c violet,magenta "bun run --cwd backend dev" "bun run --cwd frontend dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd backend build && bun run --cwd frontend build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck
